comments.author: Rassalon
comments.body:
MUST have R8 Sword Mastery + 30,000 Maritime Fame. Popped for me after 3 QMP

1. Speak to the Tavern Keeper (for quest info)
2. Go to "British Isles North" (Once there go to ruins in the north)
3. You'll see 5 sword fighters lined up. Speak to the middle one that looks different from the others to advance the quest, they will say attack them, so then....
4. Click on the middle sword fighter and attack all 5 at the same time...
5. Survive, win and go back to London to turn it in.
